articles.title: Is mental illness universal?
articles.summary:
• The essay explores whether mental disorders are universally experienced across cultures or if they are shaped by cultural contexts.  
• It questions the validity of Western psychiatric classifications when applied to non-Western societies.  
• The author suggests that mental distress may manifest differently depending on cultural beliefs and practices.  
• The discussion highlights the importance of understanding mental illness within its cultural framework to promote effective treatment.  
• Ultimately, the essay invites readers to reconsider the nature of mental health as both a universal and culturally nuanced phenomenon.
